Remark
[commutation with the scalar Laplacian]

Source: petersen:page-0345 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.14Let $X$ be a vector field on a Riemannian manifold. Show that $X$ is a Killing field if and only if $L_X$ and $\Delta $ commute on functions.
